_about: Sea step 8 RANDOM ENCOUNTERS (director 2026-11-18: enemies come as random encounters while sailing, weighted by region, weather and night; pirate ships both by size: small ones fire broadsides from range, big ones also board (8b); loot both: floating debris + drops on deck after a boarding fight). The HOST rolls (core/sea/encounter_rules.gd) every check_seconds for each player at sea outside the safe waters round the home port: chance = base x region[n] x weather x night x (anchored or moving), capped by max_foes alive; a kind is picked by weight among the kinds allowed in that region / at that hour; it comes in spawn_m away within spawn_cone_deg of the player's ship's bow (or of his facing when swimming). Pirates (core/sea/pirate_rules.gd): engage between range_m, fire when the target lies within the cannon arc and fire_range_m, flee below flee_hull, give up beyond lose_m from every player. A pirate ship sunk leaves flotsam (game/sea_flotsam.gd): count pieces, each with doubloons x the region's loot_mult, a few materials, and a chance of a rolled gun at the region's item level. ALL NUMBERS PLACEHOLDERS.

ghost_brig.name: ghost ship
ghost_brig.notice: A pale light on the water: a %s!

crews._about: Sea step 8b: pirate crews on deck (core/sea/deck_walk.gd, game/sea_crews.gd). Musketeers shoot at players within see_m; cutlass men and the captain fight whoever stands on their deck. A boarder (kind 'boarders' > 0) closes to board_keep_m abeam of a player's ship and, within board_m, swings that many of her crew across one after another (cutlass men and the captain first). Beating off the boarders leaves deck_loot chests on the defended deck; clearing a foe's own deck leaves them on hers and she strikes (no guns, no sail). Musketeers fire at players on other ships within musket_range (balls at musket_speed, led for her speed, musket_error_deg off). A crewman pushed hard past the rail (overboard_push m/s) or on a sinking ship goes into the sea, swims (swim_speed) to the nearest ship's ladder and climbs (climb_s); with no ship to reach he drowns after drown_s (no kill pay). Ships with a hold (sea step 8b-2) keep kinds[].below men in it: once a player is within below_wake_m (or her boarding starts) one climbs the companion stair every below_up_s; a player who goes down fights them there. Health / damage by region: see "threat" (sea step 8f).
crews.board_notice: Boarders! The %s's crew is swinging across
crews.repelled_notice: Boarders beaten off: they left their plunder on deck
crews.cleared_notice: The %s's crew is beaten: she strikes her colours. Her plunder is on deck

sharks._about: Sea step 8c sharks (game/sea_sharks.gd). Host keeps per_swimmer sharks for each player / pirate in deep water (inside_by >= deep_m from land), blood_extra more for one bleeding (bitten within blood_s), at most max; with nobody in the water a player on a deck in deep water gets `roaming` fins circling his ship. A hunting shark circles circle_s at circle_m (closing), then lunges (lunge_speed) and bites (bite, bite_every) within bite_m of its head. fin_depth = how deep its belly swims while circling (the dorsal fin cuts the surface). Tougher by region. harvest: a shark killed within window_s of our harpoon gives Hunting xp and these parts.

serpent._about: Sea step 8c the Tide Wyrm (game/sea_serpent.gd), a rare encounter (kinds sea_serpent: region 2+, weather_mult storm). Approaches under water (dive_speed), surfaces ring_m off the side of the ship its quarry is on for surface_s, bites her hull (bite_hull, every bite_every) and lunges at the nearest player within lunge_reach (rears up lunge_windup s, then lunge_damage to everyone within lunge_radius of the spot, every lunge_every), dives (dive_s) and comes up on her other side. Body segments take segment_share of a hit; cannon balls deal cannons.json creature_damage. Leaves when nobody is within lose_m. Hp / damage grow by region. Slain = loot afloat.
serpent.notice: Something huge moves under the water...
serpent.slain_notice: The Tide Wyrm is slain: its hoard floats free

ghosts._about: Sea step 8d ghost ships (game/sea_ghosts.gd; kinds with ghost: true, night only). She starts faded (cannon balls fly through her) and rests first_rest_s; when she wants to fire she turns solid over fade_s and stays solid solid_s (fires only once solid; hittable), then fades for rest_s. At dawn she and her crew fade out over dawn_fade_s and are gone.
ghosts.dawn_notice: First light: the ghost ship fades from the sea

drowned._about: Sea step 8d the drowned (game/sea_drowned.gd; kind drowned_rise, night only). A rising = waves waves wave_gap_s apart of per_wave (+ per_wave_per_region x (region - 1)) drowned, plus one brute from brute_from_region, coming up ring_m round the ship; they swim to her and climb her hull anywhere (game/sea_crews.gd undead swimmers), then fight on deck. In the water one within grab_notice_m of a swimming player goes for him and within grab_m holds him: hold_damage a second and pulled down (pull_speed m/s) for hold_s, or until it is hurt; it grabs again after regrab_s.
drowned.notice: Pale shapes rise in the water: the drowned are coming aboard!
drowned.grab_notice: A drowned hand drags you under!

beasts._about: Sea step 8e the regions' own creatures (game/sea_beasts.gd + game/beasts/<kind>.gd; kinds with creature 'beast', region_only = only in their own region, weather_only = only in that weather). lose_m: gone when every player is that far. Each kind: enemy (data/enemies.json), count, loot (encounters loot table), notice; its own numbers below. ALL NUMBERS MINE. Health / damage by region: see "threat" (sea step 8f).

uboat._about: Sea step 8e-4 the G U-boat sightings (game/sea_uboat.gd; LOCKED sightings with deeds: far off, dives if you close in, never caught, never blocking). check_s / chance / min_gap_s: how rarely the host shows one; surface_share: surfaced at the horizon vs a periscope; deeds: weights (torpedo_foe only when a foe is within help_m of the player). us_damage never takes a hull below keep_hull of its max. ALL NUMBERS MINE.

threat._about: Sea step 8f (core/sea/threat_rules.gd; LOCKED right ship per region + enemies grow with level). PLAYER side: every damage / health number written for sea enemies (crews, sharks, serpent, region creatures, foe cannon splash) is region 1's; in region n it is x damage_growth^(L(n) - L(1)) of data/item_levels.json, L(n) = the region's drop band start + area_offset (the same growth as armour defense and gun damage). SHIP side: hull damage numbers are for base_ship; in region n x hull(ship_by_region[n]) / hull(base_ship) (data/sea/hull.json), so the ship a region expects lasts the same in every region (tuned: ~90 s of an unrepaired fight) and a smaller one sinks faster. ALL NUMBERS MINE.
